import os, stat
os.mkdir('/data/newdir')
with open('/data/new.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('x' * 1000)
a, b, d = os.stat('/data/new.txt'), os.stat('/data/seed.txt'), os.stat('/data/newdir')
print(a.st_ino != b.st_ino, a.st_ino == os.stat('/data/new.txt').st_ino)
print(a.st_nlink, d.st_nlink, a.st_blocks, a.st_blksize)
